questions.standard_level: Geometry. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Geometry, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.response: write the answer and show the required work
questions.prompt: In △ABC and △DEF, ∠A ≅ ∠D and ∠B ≅ ∠E. Prove that △ABC ~ △DEF using similarity transformations.
questions.prompt_markup: In △ABC and △DEF, ∠A ≅ ∠D and ∠B ≅ ∠E. Prove that △ABC ~ △DEF using similarity transformations.
questions.required_method: Dilate △ABC by k = DE/AB; show the image is congruent to △DEF by ASA; conclude a dilation followed by rigid motions maps ABC onto DEF.
questions.grading_note: Any valid proof (paragraph, two-column, or flow). Essential: (1) dilate by k = DE/AB to get △A′B′C′ with A′B′ = DE; (2) dilations keep angles, so ∠A′ ≅ ∠D and ∠B′ ≅ ∠E; (3) △A′B′C′ ≅ △DEF by ASA; (4) so rigid motions map A′B′C′ onto DEF, and the dilation followed by those motions maps ABC onto DEF. Invalid: assuming the sides are proportional.
